name: comp-452
title: Breadcrumb Bordered
description: A bordered rounded strip holding a house icon, the link Components and the brighter current page Breadcrumb, spaced along one line over black.
use: When the breadcrumb must read as a distinct control over busy page content.
avoid: On a flat page with no contrasting surface: the border and shadow need something to sit against.
a11y: The icon link carries hidden Home text so it has a name; focus styling is the browser default and nothing animates. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A slim rounded rectangle with a thin slate border and faint shadow rests on black. Inside, a house glyph, a chevron, the grey word Components, another chevron and the brighter Breadcrumb sit along one row.
behaves: Hovering a link lifts it from grey to white while the frame and spacing hold still. Nothing else changes.
customise: The labels, house icon and separators are fixed in the file; a real path means editing the items. Border, padding and shadow live on the list's class.
weight: light: A few text links, one icon and a border; nothing runs or animates.
demo: Components and Breadcrumb, with a house icon.
polishWhy: Clean bordered strip with even spacing; the frame is its only distinguishing touch.
